info.author: xcode
info.comment: Flat vector UI chrome: primary button plate. A horizontal rounded rectangle (radius modest), fill bright blue #2F6FED, thin navy #1B3A6B outline, two small white corner ticks like a form stamp. No text, no letters, no icons of food, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, clean geometric lines, isolated on light gray #E6EBF2.
